text: The guide was warm and answered all our questions. Best part of our trip.
We waited almost an hour before the tour started and nobody told us why.
Hard to find the farm, the road was bumpy and the map took us to the wrong gate.
The fresh fruit tasting at the end was delicious!
The lunch was cold and bland, quite disappointing.
It felt like a staged show, not a real working farm.
I learned so much about how the crops are grown and harvested, and it all felt genuine.
Too expensive for what you get: two hours of walking and nothing included.
Great value for money, the price included a meal and a tasting.
The toilets were dirty and there was nowhere clean to sit.
Clean, tidy and comfortable seating under the trees.
Started exactly on time and everything was well organised.
Easy to find, and the directions you sent were perfect.
The guide was rude and seemed bored. Would not recommend.
The walk was too long and exhausting in the heat, with no shade at all.
We had a lovely time and will definitely come back next year with friends.
It would be great to have a cooking class or a sunset tour as well.
Lovely walk and a friendly host, but we waited 30 minutes and the toilets were not clean.
Everything was fine.
Overpriced, and the guide kept trying to sell us souvenirs.
We loved harvesting the vegetables ourselves and the kids enjoyed it so much.
A half-day option would be nice, the full day was too long for us.
Amazing hospitality, the family welcomed us like old friends and we ate home-cooked food.
Waste of money. Late start, rude staff, dirty place. Never again.
Great experience, highly recommend to anyone visiting the area.

Spotless place and excellent tea and snacks.

Reasonably priced and honest. Not fancy but real farm life, and we loved it.
गाइड बहुत मिलनसार थे और हर सवाल का जवाब दिया।
टूर एक घंटा देर से शुरू हुआ और किसी ने कुछ बताया नहीं।
खेत ढूँढना बहुत मुश्किल था, रास्ते में कोई बोर्ड नहीं था।
ताज़े फल और घर का बना खाना बहुत स्वादिष्ट था।
खाना ठंडा और बेस्वाद था, मज़ा नहीं आया।
हमें खेती के बारे में बहुत कुछ सीखने को मिला, सब कुछ असली लगा।
कीमत बहुत ज़्यादा है, इतने पैसे में कुछ खास नहीं मिला।
पैसे वसूल! बहुत अच्छा अनुभव, हम दोबारा ज़रूर आएँगे।
शौचालय बहुत गंदा था और बैठने की जगह भी साफ़ नहीं थी।
सब कुछ साफ़-सुथरा था और बैठने का इंतज़ाम बढ़िया था।
काश शाम का कोई छोटा टूर या खाना बनाने की क्लास भी होती।
गाइड का व्यवहार बहुत रूखा था, मज़ा किरकिरा हो गया।
चलना बहुत ज़्यादा था और धूप में बहुत थकान हो गई।
टूर समय पर शुरू हुआ और सब कुछ अच्छी तरह संभाला गया।
Guide bahut acche the, humein bahut kuch seekhne ko mila.
Tour time pe shuru nahi hua, ek ghanta wait karna pada. Bakwas intezaam.
Khana bahut accha tha, par farm dhundhna mushkil tha.
Paise zyada liye, utna mazaa nahi aaya.
Bahut mast experience tha, doston ko zaroor batayenge.
Toilet ganda tha aur baithne ki jagah bhi theek nahi thi.
